essence: Mere will fruits as three worlds; workings reach past knowing; work-stair climbed by Brahmā.
Power-creeper blooming as gods protects; Mṛḍa errorless, reachless, praised everywhere.
Pride claiming made-of-you yet not in self; rest in mind-bliss after weighing duties.
Subtle yet whole, gross yet unseen; word-nets toiled in vain without you-as-expressible.
Course, rite, wisdom asked: show by teaching, grant grace.

sections.SUMMARY: Bare will bears triple fruit past measure; gods shinny the deed-ladder toward one abode. The power-vine flowers into deities and shields; the stainless one stands unguessed and unreached, hymned in act, memory, vision, touch, arrival. Pride apes union while missing the self; then duty pondered drops into blissful rest. Fineness holds all yet hides from seers; tongues net nothing till you name yourself speakable. So the plea: which road, which rite, which ken reveals you — teach and favour.

rasa.justification: Unknowable reach, unfindable error, unseen grossness, unspoken expressible: wonder circling into plea for teaching.
